function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At 10 kPa (≈0.098 atm) the melting/freezing point of pure water drops to roughly **–2 °C**.  
In other words, water will freeze at about –2 °C when the ambient pressure is 10 kPa.
